BL-1528 — An undeliverable closing-ceremony note is a FAILED run, never a pending one: when swarm_handoff.sh refuses the lean-packet note (recipient absent from the roster, tmux inject failed, any non-zero exit) runClosingCeremony stores the run as failed with the refusal text, appends closing-lean-packet-undeliverable to the loud log, and the night sequence still advances - today the run is written BEFORE the send, the CLI fatals, the next sweep sees already_exists and moves on, and the failure surfaces two days later as a note to the same absent role
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the store's pending state keeps its meaning "the packet note was accepted by swarm_handoff.sh" - the fix makes a refused send a failed run, it does not add a fourth state or retry the s…
BL-1528 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1528" (or "reject BL-1528 <reason>") to act.
